title: Wallpaper
subtitle: Animated images and videos as your desktop background, behind the icons. Everything you add is kept in the Hydraflow library (also used by the liquid cooler screen). Drag files here to add them.
pickFirst: Pick an image or video below first
pauseMaximizedHint: Saves CPU and GPU while the wallpaper is hidden. The last frame stays on screen.
emptyText: Add GIFs, images (PNG, JPG, WebP) or videos (MP4, WebM) — with the button or by dragging them here. Then just click one to put it on your desktop.
